he Company conducts business in virtually all countries of the world with the primary focus on products related to human health and well-being. 

 The Company is organized into two business segments: Innovative Medicine and MedTech. The Innovative Medicine segment is focused on the following therapeutic areas: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience, Pulmonary Hypertension, Infectious Diseases, and Cardiovascular and Metabolism. comment_letters.staff_ask: Staff asked J&J to disclose the material terms of the Genmab license for Darzalex and Darzalex Faspro (aggregate paid, royalty rate range, term and termination) and to file the agreement as an exhibit.
comment_letters.company_answer: J&J said the license is ordinary course and need not be filed, but agreed to add the 12%-20% royalty range and annual royalty paid (about $2B in 2024) to future 10-Ks.
comment_letters.next_filing_disclosure: FY2025 10-K Item 1 now states: Darzalex franchise 15.0% of revenue; royalty 12% to 20% of total Darzalex net sales; royalties to Genmab ~$2.4B (2025) and ~$2.0B (2024); Genmab patent families expire US 2029, EU 2031/2032. Agreement still not filed as an exhibit.
comment_letters.why_it_matters: A royalty of up to 20% on J&J's largest product (about $2.4B a year) was disclosed only because the SEC asked; it is a margin lever tied to 2029 patent expiry that the segment tables never showed.
comment_letters.impact_estimate: ~$2.4B royalty paid FY2025 (10-K); implied Darzalex sales ~$14B+ at 15.0% of revenue; royalty stops on the Genmab families after US 2029 expiry if J&J's own Faspro patents hold.

comment_letters.staff_ask: Staff asked whether J&J should disclose its BARDA and other government COVID-19 vaccine agreements, their terms, and how the amounts were recognized.
comment_letters.company_answer: J&J said the up-to-$1B BARDA cost-share was not material (booked as a reduction of R&D under ASC 730-20) and redacted the 2020 dollar amounts under Rule 83 confidential treatment.
comment_letters.why_it_matters: Shows R&D was reported net of government reimbursement with the amounts redacted from the public letter.
comment_letters.impact_estimate: Up to $1B reimbursement over 2020-2025 against $12.2B total 2020 R&D (reply); exact 2020 offset redacted.
comment_letters.staff_quote: Please tell us your consideration of disclosing material agreements entered into with U.S. and other governments for the development and distribution of your COVID-19 vaccine, the significant terms of such agreements and how related amounts have been recognized in your financial statements.
comment_letters.reply_quote: Consistent with the application of these factors we determined the above-referenced agreement with BARDA is not material and our disclosures are adequate as further outlined below.
